name: Rafael von Fortner-Feuerbach
original_name: ラファエル・フォン・フォルトナー・フォイエルバッハ
source: He originally came from the lower class people of the Empire, but became an aristocrat through the Republican independence movement. He also runs orphanages and hospitals, providing care to underprivileged citizens. He has a soft demeanor and is very good-natured, but behind the scenes...
